set.body:
Owner: fmri-workflow/dataset; BIDS selection semantics remain BIDS4s. Consumer: PLS Neuro W1, bd-01M1YVQ3V8ESWPJAYHQFQ3S6GT. Reproducer: FirstLevelWorkbenchProbe in the PLS Neuro repository, admitted fd992a0c plus candidate 1d62a1a. With recipe.confounds=None, BidsStudyCompiler drops the optional confounds reference and FirstLevelUnitDataset.open never reads that table. BidsStudyCompiler.confoundCompanion can find it and BidsProjectLoader.readTable can read it, but there is no reusable optional first-level review binding independent of fitted nuisance. Existing NuisanceColumns consumer bridges discovery for header review; do not grow a second application loader.
Provide a metadata/table-only public review API: identified optional companions and raw motion/QC columns, original run-local scan identity, units/provenance from source metadata, missing values preserved, explicit absent/ambiguous/invalid states, row-count validation and cancellation/resource boundaries. Fitted nuisance selection must remain separate and unchanged. Support configurable producers, not hard-coded fMRIPrep ingestion. Known FD/translation/rotation metadata and raw/standardized DVARS need distinct quantity definitions; do not infer finite zeros from n/a or assign unproven units. Review must not open/stage whole BOLD payloads. Retain source receipts sufficient for downstream stale-data checks.
Acceptance: shared binding JVM+JS tests and JVM public IO tests for present QC with no fitted nuisance, absent optional tables, duplicate companions, changed sources, wrong row count, n/a and nonnumeric cells; proof of no BOLD data reads. Integrate native JavaFX motion/scan selection against exact original rows. Implementation remains open.
set.title: Workflow review: load optional motion and QC companions independently of nuisance fitting
